checkedAlternates.risk: Chiffonade produces thin strips like Julienne.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Chiffonade is rolled leafy-herb/green ribbons (group-1), whereas Julienne is cut from firm root/stem vegetables into rectangular sticks (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Brunoise is cut directly from Julienne strips.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Brunoise is a 3 mm cubic dice (group-4), not an elongated stick (group-3).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
